subject.title: Stale .jsonl.lock + stuck typing indicator after EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError on parallel subagent fan-out

question: Should this issue remain the concrete coordination tracker for the parallel subagent takeover/lock/typing cluster, or should the remaining pieces be redirected to the broader run-lifecycle umbrella and narrower linked issues?
rationale: The remaining symptoms are real, but solving them crosses session-fence policy, subagent delivery durability, typing cleanup, and open PR sequencing rather than one isolated patch.

options.title: Keep This Coordinator
options.body: Keep this issue open as the concrete field-evidence tracker while reviewing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89039, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91797, and the related delivery/typing trackers.

options.title: Redirect To Umbrella
options.body: Close or mark this as superseded only after maintainers decide https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101863 is the canonical owner for this exact field report and preserve the unique logs there.

options.title: Split Remaining Slices
options.body: Move message loss, fence false positives, typing cleanup, and live-holder lock recovery into separate canonical issues, then close this only after each slice has an owner.

recommendation.title: Keep This Coordinator
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the concrete field-evidence tracker while reviewing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89039, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91797, and the related delivery/typing trackers.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger is the strongest available routing candidate from the sampled session-lock and typing history for deciding whether this stays as a concrete tracker or is split across owner lanes.
